name: Modals
purpose: Modals focus the user's attention on an important message or side-task without removing them from their journey. Family: Dialog (interrupts the view and requires an action/decision to continue), Video modal (responsive video overlay), and Partial modal / Drawer (app-only, anchored to the bottom of the screen, houses supplementary content/actions the user can view and interact with alongside the underlying UI).
when: interrupts = required — the person must stop: confirm a consequential action, or finish a task that cannot share the screen; yields to split-button when interrupts = none AND actions >= 2 (one main action with a few related ones beside it), and to dropdown when interrupts = none AND options >= 5 (one choice from a list, made in place, s270-D1).
$family: Covers the 'Modals' canvas across three sections: Modal - dialog, Modal - video, Modal - partial (app only).

variants.name: dialog
variants.use: Overlay that interrupts the user and requires an action/decision. Non-native; buttons default / two-buttons / stacked. ('Dialogs for mobile').

variants.name: video
variants.use: Responsive video-player overlay (XL/L/M/MS/S/XS). Surface + close + caption over a dimmed, blurred backdrop.

variants.name: partial
variants.use: App-only Drawer anchored to the bottom; supplementary content/actions; elevate above level 0 (shadow at rest, overlay when expanded). Include search where appropriate.

build.$status: PROMOTED 2026-06-22 (Dave) — gated reference: snippets/Modals.reference.html (DIALOG variant). Build green; prototype-grade 9.0/9 (board: 7 at 9/9).
build.scope: Dialog only. Video modal + Partial/drawer remain a separate, larger follow-up (flagged, not built).
build.buttonInheritance: CTAs are the canon Button (mirror of Button.reference.html) — primary/secondary + the promoted scale-physics. Atom-reuse, not a bespoke button. Secondary border corrected to tertiary/border/default (was form/border).
build.fidelity: Primary button ordered FIRST (left in a row / top when stacked), left-aligned — per Figma node 1076:73406; the prior canon had it last/right-aligned.
build.motion: Scale + fade entrance on the SAME spring as the button (motion/easing/spring @ motion/duration/spring); backdrop fades (motion/duration/fade). Reduced-motion snaps. Chosen (Dave) to mirror the button motion language.
build.backdrop: DIM scrim (overlay/version1), NOT blur. Decision (Dave 2026-06-22): dim preserves glance-ability of the page and avoids the low-vision/legibility + cognitive cost of backdrop blur (documented a11y hazard; OSes ship 'Reduce Transparency'; blur/overlay is 0 in dark anyway). If blur is ever used it must gate behind prefers-reduced-transparency and never be a load-bearing modality cue.
build.a11y: role=dialog + aria-modal + aria-labelledby + aria-describedby; focus moves in + Tab trapped within + Esc closes + focus returns to trigger; background inert; trigger disabled while open. Closes the meta's focus-trap REVIEW item.
build.prototypeGrade: 9.0/9 (2026-06-22). Square corners; responsive actions stack <=480px (Figma 'stacked' form).
